title: [Master]-]Withholding Tax Entries are not generated at payment because the Withholding Tax. Prod. Posting Group field gets not transferred to the payment line
summary: The withholding tax production posting group is now transferred to payment lines during payment processing, fixing missing withholding tax entry generation.
key_points: Withholding tax production posting group was not being transferred to payment lines
This caused withholding tax journal entries to fail to generate at payment
Added logic in the withholding tax journal subscriber codeunit to handle the transfer
Includes test coverage for the fix in the test codeunit
